```{r}
#| label: setup
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(knitr)
})
source("R/prep.R")
source("R/positioning.R")  # the coverage of the fifteen questions and the key figures, as in positioning.qmd

# dark, like the other square images: light ink on a near-black page, charts on a transparent background
INK <- "#f3f1ea"; MUTED <- "#a9a7a0"; GRID <- "#2a2e36"
# the three works in their dark-page shades
DARK <- c(RTS = "#2FBF8F", UN = "#5AA2FF", "This study" = "#FF6A4D")
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 15, base_family = "Inter") +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = NA), panel.background = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = NA),
        text = element_text(colour = INK), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = GRID, linewidth = 0.3),
        axis.text = element_text(colour = MUTED), axis.title = element_text(colour = MUTED),
        legend.position = "none"))
knitr::opts_chunk$set(dev.args = list(bg = "transparent"))
n_m <- sum(cov$`This study` == "m"); n_q <- nrow(cov); n_u <- sum(cov$UN != "a")
```

  {\fontsize{12}{14}\selectfont\bfseries\color{#1}\MakeUppercase{#2}\par}\vspace{0.4em}

  {\fontsize{13.5}{17}\selectfont\color{fg}#4\par}\vfill
  {\fontsize{11}{13}\selectfont\color{dim}#5\par}\end{tcolorbox}}
\begin{minipage}[t]{0.315\linewidth}\work{green}{The alert}{RTS}{A viral test: ice-breakers for an Italian, ``keep your distance'' for an Algerian.}{No count of prompts, no control. August 2026.}\end{minipage}\hfill
\begin{minipage}[t]{0.315\linewidth}\work{keyblue}{The framework}{UN}{Report \href{https://docs.un.org/en/A/HRC/56/68}{\color{linkblue}A/HRC/56/68}: how AI feeds racial discrimination, what to require.}{A synthesis; no test of its own. June 2024.}\end{minipage}\hfill
\begin{minipage}[t]{0.315\linewidth}\work{heat}{The measure}{This study}{The same question, `r num(nrow(R), 0)` times, to 7 open-weight AIs. Only his nationality changes.}{24 nationalities and a control. Nov.\ 2026.}\end{minipage}
\vfill
\newpage

<!-- 2: coverage of the fifteen questions -->
```{=latex}
\kicker{keyblue}{Read against the UN report}
\headline{Of `r n_q` questions on AI bias, the study measures `r n_m`.}
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 3.1
cov_long |>
  count(work, level, .drop = FALSE) |>
  mutate(level = factor(level, levels = rev(LEVELS))) |>
  ggplot(aes(n, work, fill = work, alpha = level)) +
  geom_col(colour = "#0f1115", linewidth = 1.2, width = 0.72) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(n >= 4, paste(n, tolower(level)), ifelse(n > 0, n, ""))),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), colour = INK, size = 5.4, alpha = 1, family = "Inter",
            fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = DARK) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("Measured" = 0.95, "Illustrated" = 0.6, "Stated" = 0.35, "Not covered" = 0.1)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = NULL, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(names(DARK))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_text(colour = INK, face = "bold", size = 17))
```

<!-- 3: the UN asks for tests -->
```{=latex}
\kicker{heat}{From recommendation to tool}
\headline{The UN asks for tests. Here is one.}
\vspace{0.2em}
\newcommand{\rec}[3]{\begin{tile}{heat}{\fontsize{11}{13}\selectfont\color{keyblue}\textbf{UN #1}\enspace\color{dim}#2\par}\vspace{0.15em}
  {\fontsize{15}{19}\selectfont\color{fg}#3\par}\end{tile}}
\rec{§68 d}{test before deployment}{\textbf{A protocol:} change one word, the nationality, and compare with ``a man''.}
\rec{§68 m}{audit over time}{\textbf{Rerun it} on free Kaggle GPUs, \href{https://github.com/adriens/kaggle-bench-ai-biasses\#resources}{\color{linkblue}public Kaggle notebooks}; each new model joins the seven.}
\rec{§68 k}{disaggregated data}{\textbf{Rates by nationality, situation and age,} every answer published.}
\rec{§68 f}{transparency}{\textbf{Open models, open data,} a judge that quotes before it labels.}
\vfill
\newpage
```
